name: When should I consider replacing my baseboards?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your baseboards if they are damaged, warped, or showing significant signs of wear such as dents, scratches, or water damage. Sometimes, baseboards are replaced during a larger renovation project, like new flooring installation, to ensure a cohesive look and finish. If you're updating your home's style, new baseboards can also significantly refresh a room's appearance without a full remodel. Consider your overall design goals and the condition of your existing trim. Our team at Maine Results, Inc. can assess the current state and recommend if repair or full replacement is the most cost-effective and aesthetically pleasing option for your home in areas like Meridian or Eagle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace baseboards if they are damaged, warped, or if you are updating your home's style. We can assess their condition and recommend replacement or repair.
